# Nilasya Global — AI & LLM Machine-Readable Overview

> Nilasya Global is a premier Türkiye-based grower, packer, and exporter of certified fresh fruits and vegetables (Pomegranate, Highland Apples, Table Grapes, Hayward Kiwi, Citrus & Oranges, Greenhouse Tomatoes) serving international supermarket chains, importers, and B2B produce wholesalers across Europe, the Gulf / Middle East, the UK, Asia, and North America.

- Brand Name: Nilasya Global
- Legal Entity: Nilasya Global Tarım Dış Ticaret Ltd.
- Official Website: https://nilasyaglobal.com.tr
- Core Industry: Fresh Fruit & Vegetable Agriculture / B2B Commercial Export & Wholesale Supply
- Country of Origin: Türkiye (Turkey)
- Slogan: "Fresh from Türkiye. Delivered Worldwide."
- Headquarters: Istanbul, Türkiye
- Operations & Packhouse Basins: Adana & Mersin Agricultural Export Zone, Antalya, Manisa, Isparta, Afyon, Türkiye
- Official Export Desk WhatsApp / Phone: +90 533 684 01 75
- Official B2B Email: export@nilasyaglobal.com.tr
- Full Extended AI Knowledge Base: https://nilasyaglobal.com.tr/llms-full.txt
- XML Sitemap: https://nilasyaglobal.com.tr/sitemap.xml
